description: The Global Hubs air-cargo table ranks 50 cargo airlines, combination carriers and express operators by 2024 cargo tonne-kilometres. Dmitry Golubnichiy publishes CSV and Parquet files with operator and headquarters fields, a throughput measure, revenue where disclosed and a basis flag for the estimate. The dataset has a public Zenodo concept DOI; repository and Zenodo metadata state CC0, so access is free. It can help an aviation modeller set broad carrier-scale freight capacity or compare disruption scenarios across operators. The README says ranks 1 to 26 reproduce IATA WATS figures, while ranks 27 to 50 are mostly estimates from tonnes and stage length or revenue and yield proxies. Those ranks do not have the same evidence strength. The geographic unit is a carrier, not an airport or route, and the ranking year is 2024. This review did not download data rows or verify underlying IATA and carrier disclosures. Related Global Hubs resources describe cargo airports and other freight operators.
